title: High Discharge Pressure on Crude Charge Pump P-1001A
symptoms: Pressure transmitter PT-1001 reads 18.5 bar (normal 12.0 bar)
Flow transmitter FT-1001 dropped to 45 m3/h (normal 110 m3/h)
Motor current spiked to 142 A (trip threshold 150 A)

title: Severe Cavitation on Atmospheric Tower Reflux Pump P-1004B
symptoms: Vibration transmitter VT-1004 reads 9.8 mm/s RMS (threshold 4.5 mm/s)
Suction pressure PT-1004S below NPSH minimum
Acoustic sensor detects high frequency bubble collapse

title: Tube Leak / Differential Pressure Spike in Heat Exchanger E-101
symptoms: Secondary side temperature TT-1012 rising rapidly
Shell/tube differential pressure dPT-101 exceeded 3.2 bar limit
Hydrocarbon traces detected in cooling water outlet

title: Overpressure in Atmospheric Distillation Column C-101
symptoms: Overhead pressure PT-1010 at 4.2 bar (design limit 4.5 bar)
Tray 14 differential pressure indicates liquid holdup

title: Control Valve Sticking on Furnace Fuel Gas Line FCV-1001
symptoms: Valve position feedback differs from demand by 18%
Furnace bridge-wall temperature TT-1001 oscillating +/- 25 C
